name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for dismantling and rebuilding radios, a hobby nurtured by his grandfather, a retired electrical engineer himself. After graduating from the University of Edinburgh with a degree in Electronics, he cut his teeth working for a small engineering firm specializing in automotive sensors. The thrill of competition drew him to motorsport, and he quickly transitioned to Formula Ford before landing a role in the World Endurance Championship.

Alistair approaches his work with a meticulous eye for detail, believing that the smallest adjustments can yield significant performance gains. He's known for his ability to diagnose and resolve complex electrical issues quickly and efficiently under pressure. His calm demeanor and systematic problem-solving skills are invaluable assets to the team, especially during high-stakes races. He's constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible, always seeking new and innovative ways to optimize the car's electrical systems.

What sets Alistair apart is his unique blend of old-school engineering principles and cutting-edge technology. He's just as comfortable troubleshooting a wiring harness with a multimeter as he is programming a complex ECU algorithm. This versatility makes him a highly sought-after member of the Iron Dames team.
